purpose: Define cash-movement taxonomy and Cash Bridge semantics without mixing liquidity movement with Revenue, COGS or expense recognition.

event_shape.amount_truth: financial-truth.v1 record with group=CASH and metric=cash_movement_amount

bridge_shape.categorized_inflows: calculator output: categorized_known_inflows; exact known evidenced amounts/counts
bridge_shape.categorized_outflows: calculator output: categorized_known_outflows; exact known evidenced amounts/counts
bridge_shape.transfers: calculator output; INTERNAL_TRANSFER neutral only for proven consolidated scope
bridge_shape.computed_ending_balance: financial-truth.v1 metric cash_computed_ending_balance; formula opening + known inflows - known outflows only under COMPLETE coverage
bridge_shape.cash_variance: financial-truth.v1 metric cash_variance; observed ending - computed ending

rules: Cash Bridge is liquidity truth, not Profit and Loss recognition.
TASK-055 defines taxonomy and normalization only; TASK-056 performs bridge arithmetic.
Cash movement event amounts must use Financial Truth V1 semantics and finite non-negative values. Missing never becomes zero.
Zero-value cash movement is not an event and fails closed; opening/ending balance metrics may later prove an explicit zero under Financial Truth rules.
ACTUAL cash movement requires explicit valid Financial Truth period, scope, source, as_of, reconciliation status and lineage plus cash_movement_proven=true.
Payment method CASH/BANK/MOMO/OTHER is metadata and never proves an account/location balance.
INTERNAL_TRANSFER is neutral for consolidated enterprise liquidity. Account-level treatment may later use two evidenced legs without double-counting consolidated liquidity.
Revenue recognition is not cash collection. FoodApp gross is not settlement cash. Provider settlement may become SALES_COLLECTION only for evidenced covered provider/date scope.
Purchase/AP is not cash outflow. Only evidenced ACTIVE supplier payment movement can support SUPPLIER_PAYMENT. VOID payment is excluded.
Expense recognition is not payment timing. Supplier payment is not COGS.
Debt draw and repayment are financing cash movements, not operating Revenue/OPEX.
Owner contribution/withdrawal requires structured evidenced movement. Free-text Owner note is insufficient.
Capex cash movement is an outflow but is not automatically operating expense.
Unknown classification fails closed. OTHER_EVIDENCED_INFLOW/OUTFLOW is valid only when direction and actual cash movement are already proven.
Unknown branch/channel never becomes ALL. ALL requires aggregate_proven=true.
Opening balance and observed ending balance are separate Financial Truth metrics and are never derived from payment-method rows.
Computed ending and cash variance remain non-numeric/GAP until TASK-056 has all required evidenced inputs. Missing opening or observed ending is never synthetic zero.
Source/evidence/lineage/event identity must be privacy-safe and must not contain Drive IDs/URLs, raw private records, credentials or secrets.

computed_ending_balance: valid explicit target period and scope
dependency_graph.observed_ending_balance: independent Financial Truth input; not a dependency of computed ending

calculator_rules: Coverage is caller-provided evidence. Record presence, sparse dates, or an empty event array never infer COMPLETE.
Known evidenced inflow/outflow sums may remain numeric for valid ACTUAL/ESTIMATE events under PARTIAL/MISSING coverage, but they do not prove a complete-period total.
Computed ending is numeric only when opening and eligible event dependencies are numeric ACTUAL/ESTIMATE and explicit event-source coverage is COMPLETE.
Observed ending is independent of computed ending. Missing observed ending cannot erase a valid computed ending.
Cash variance is numeric only when both computed ending and observed ending are numeric.
Derived quality follows deterministic precedence NOT_CONNECTED > GAP > ESTIMATE > ACTUAL; an ESTIMATE dependency caps its derived component at ESTIMATE.
A GAP dependency makes the corresponding derived component GAP/null. A directly missing required connection makes it NOT_CONNECTED/null.
INTERNAL_TRANSFER is excluded from consolidated inflow/outflow arithmetic. Scoped/account-level transfer arithmetic is unsupported in V1 and fails closed when neutrality cannot be proven.
Stable event_id + identical canonical event is de-duplicated. A conflicting same event_id fails closed. No-ID events are never de-duplicated merely because their visible fields match.
Opening and observed ending balances are Financial Truth CASH metrics at target start/end respectively. Explicit proven zero is valid; missing is never zero.
Negative balances are not prohibited by this generic calculator. Cash movement event amounts remain positive magnitudes whose direction is carried separately.
Payment method remains metadata and never creates a balance.
The calculator performs no source-specific recognition-to-cash mapping; raw inputs are accepted only through normalizeCashEvent().
